claude_proposed_widenings.name: half_damage_of_fail
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Burning Hands deals half damage on a successful save. This is a relative modifier on the failed-save damage, not an independent dice expression. Halving odd die counts is not representable as a DiceAmount (3d6/2 = 1.5d6, 5d6/2 = 2.5d6), and any approximation is statistically wrong. A new EffectAtom variant — or an optional flag on save_gate — is needed to express 'half of the onFail damage, rounded down.'
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: taking 3d6 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one
